name: wilayah-indonesia
description: Indonesian administrative regions with Kemendagri codes: provinces, regencies/cities, districts and villages, lookups with full addresses, and name search (no API key)

nodes.title: List provinces
nodes.description: All 38 provinces of Indonesia with their 2-digit Kemendagri codes

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List regencies and cities
nodes.description: Regencies (kabupaten) and cities (kota) of a province

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List districts
nodes.description: Districts (kecamatan) of a regency or city

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List villages
nodes.description: Villages of a district: desa and kelurahan (type) with their 10-digit codes

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get region
nodes.description: One region by Kemendagri code (dots optional, e.g. 32.73.07.1001 or 3273071001): name, level, village type (desa/kelurahan), parents and full address

code.description: Kemendagri code of a province, regency/city, district or village

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Search regions
nodes.description: Find provinces, regencies/cities, districts or villages by name (case and accent insensitive, every word must match), best matches first, with full addresses

query.description: One region name or part of it, e.g. "coblong" or "kota bandung" (narrow with level and within_code)

within_code.description: Only regions under this code, e.g. 32 (Jawa Barat) or 32.73 (Kota Bandung)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
